title: Framework sidebar: rolled-up unread badge needs a ux/Tree row-template addition

message.text: Deferred from the card-size/badge follow-up on /framework/: the owner wants the sidebar's own "Framework" link to show a rolled-up unread-item total (Framework (3) → modules with items → that module's inbox). The per-card badge is built and scaffolded (0/hidden). The sidebar total needs a small row-template addition to ux/Tree (no badge/count slot exists there today) — worth doing once @mastermind-servex-10's card-pipeline module-card data (the real count source) has a known shape, so the API is designed against real data instead of guessed.
